# cldr_utils v2.29.7 - Table of Contents

> Map, Calendar, Digits, Decimal, HTTP, Macro, Math, and String helpers for ex_cldr.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [License](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [Cldr Utils](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Cldr.Decimal](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Decimal.md): Adds a compatibility layer for functions which changed
either semantics or returns types between Decimal version
1.x and 2.x.
- [Cldr.Digits](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Digits.md): Abstract representation of number (integer, float, Decimal) in tuple form
and functions for transformations on number parts.
- [Cldr.Enum](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Enum.md)
- [Cldr.Helpers](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Helpers.md): General purpose helper functions for CLDR

- [Cldr.Http](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Http.md): Supports securely downloading https content.
- [Cldr.Json](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Json.md): A wrapper for the OTP 27 :json module.
- [Cldr.Map](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Map.md): Functions for transforming maps, keys and values.

- [Cldr.Math](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Math.md): Math helper functions for number formatting.

- [Cldr.String](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.String.md): Functions that operate on a `String.t` that are not provided
in the standard lib.

- [Cldr.Utils](https://cldr-utils.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.Utils.md): CLDR Utility functions.
